import type { Guide } from '../data/guide-docs'

interface MdxDocument { id: string; data: { title: string; description: string } }
interface StructuredGuide { id: string; data: { guide: Guide; order: number } }

/** One route registry for authored MDX and the existing executable guide data. */
export function documentationPaths<Document extends MdxDocument>(documents: Document[], guides: StructuredGuide[]) {
  const entries = [
    ...documents.map(document => ({ params: { guide: document.id }, props: { document } })),
    ...guides.map(entry => ({
      params: { guide: entry.id }, props: { guide: entry.data.guide, index: entry.data.order }
    }))
  ]
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const route = entry.params.guide
    if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\/[a-z0-9-]+)*$/.test(route)) throw new Error(`Invalid documentation route: ${route}`)
    if (seen.has(route)) throw new Error(`Duplicate documentation route: ${route}`)
    seen.add(route)
  }
  return entries
}
